message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on highways with 2–3 lanes.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.002 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code §545.003 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for drivers 21+.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %).
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail. | Texas Transportation Code §545.004 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Yield” signs give priority to the vehicle already in the intersection. | Texas Transportation Code §545.005 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during rain, fog, or low visibility.
• Fog lights only when visibility < 200 ft. | Texas Transportation Code §545.006 | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Towing of vehicles requires a permit if the vehicle is not registered.
• Tow‑away of abandoned vehicles is allowed under specific conditions. | Texas Transportation Code §545.007 | | **Parking** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or on sidewalks.
• Parking in a handicap space requires a valid permit. | Texas Transportation Code §545.008 | | **School Bus** | • All vehicles must stop for a school bus that is stopped with its red lights flashing and stop sign extended. | Texas Transportation Code §545.009 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers. | Texas Transportation Code §545.010 | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Must carry proof of registration and insurance.
• Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 bodily injury per person, $60,000 per accident, $25,000 property damage. | Texas Transportation Code §545.011 | | **Traffic Violations & Penalties** | • Points system: 4 points for most violations, 6 for DUI.
• 12 points within 3 years leads to license suspension. | Texas Transportation Code §545.012 | | **Emergency Vehicles** | • Must yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens. | Texas Transportation Code §545.013 | ### How to Stay Updated - **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website: [txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) - **Texas Transportation Code** – Full text available online via the Texas Legislature’s website. - **Local County Courts** – For specific local ordinances or recent changes. ### Quick Tips 1. **Always check the posted speed limit** – it can change at construction zones or school zones. 2. **Use hands‑free** – even if you’re just texting a quick message. 3. **Keep your insurance card in the glove compartment** – you’ll need it if pulled over. 4. **Know the school bus rules** – stopping for a school bus is mandatory and can result in a fine if ignored. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular situation!
